predecessors.note: The Semirechye and Fergana lands of the Turkestan ASSR; the page gives no districts.

successors.note: Renamed the Socialist Republic of Kyrgyzstan on 30 October 1990 and the Republic of Kyrgyzstan on 15 December 1990 or 5 February 1991; independent 31 August 1991; recognised 26 December 1991.

capitals.name: Frunze (Bishkek)
capitals.note: Infobox: Frunze; the page gives no date for the choice of Frunze and does not mention Pishpek.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 166,914 km2 (the Natural Earth country; the page gives no area): the Kara-Kirghiz Autonomous Oblast of 14 October 1924, the Kirghiz ASSR of 1 February 1926 and the union republic of 5 December 1936 in the borders of today's Kyrgyzstan. The page gives no border change and no districts; the land lies inside Cliopatria's Union of Soviet Socialist Republics shapes, and Kyrgyzstan begins in 1992.

ledger.note: 1924, 14 October: "Established on 14 October 1924 as the Kara-Kirghiz Autonomous Oblast of the RSFSR". The page names no districts; the land is the Semirechye and Fergana lands of the Turkestan ASSR now in Kyrgyzstan.

region.text: the Kara-Kirghiz Autonomous Oblast of the RSFSR (Kirghiz ASSR from 1926)

ledger.note: 1924, 14 October: "Established on 14 October 1924 as the Kara-Kirghiz Autonomous Oblast of the RSFSR". [Reviewer eu-17-x: mirror of the RSFSR dossier's vassal_start.]
1926, 1 February: the oblast is "transformed into the Kirghiz ASSR", "still being a part of the RSFSR".
1936, 5 December: "it became a separate constituent republic of the USSR" with the 1936 Constitution.

region.text: the Kirghiz ASSR leaves the RSFSR as a union republic

ledger.note: 1936, 5 December: "it became a separate constituent republic of the USSR". [Reviewer eu-17-x: mirror of the RSFSR dossier's vassal_end.]

1990, 30 October: "the Kirghiz SSR was renamed to the Socialist Republic of Kyrgyzstan"; the Republic of Kyrgyzstan name is dated 15 December 1990 in the text, 30 December 1990 for sovereignty and 5 February 1991 for the name in the infobox.
1991, 31 August: "it transformed into independent Kyrgyzstan"; the Soviet Union dissolved on 26 December 1991.

certainty.note: The page names no districts or border changes; the 1924-1936 lines are today's borders.

sources.title: Kirghiz Soviet Socialist Republic
sources.note: 14 October 1924 Kara-Kirghiz AO; 1 February 1926 Kirghiz ASSR; 5 December 1936 union republic; 30 October 1990, 15 December 1990 and 5 February 1991 names; 31 August 1991; capital Frunze; no area.

notes: No Cliopatria row; the land lies inside Union of Soviet Socialist Republics shapes (1924-1991); Cliopatria's Kyrgyzstan begins in 1992. The republic is an internal unit of the Soviet Union (an autonomous oblast and then an ASSR of the RSFSR until 5 December 1936; the RSFSR dossier records it as a vassal). The page is inconsistent on the 1990-1991 names (30 October 1990, 15 December 1990, 30 December 1990, 5 February 1991). It is silent on the area, on Pishpek, and on border changes with Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Tajikistan; the Kazakh dossier gives the Semirechye lands to the Kazakh SSR. Counterpart turkestan-assr has a dossier.
